cross_market_insights: All four markets read the query as local date ideas or experience gift vouchers; no top 10 result is a travel guide to experiences abroad.
Only Viator (Sydney rank 6) and VisitBritain (London rank 7) touch travel; Viator is a booking list with no planning help.
No result groups experiences by type, gives a season and a caveat, or flags safety, permits or marine park rules.
Strong December gift spike in AU: an 'experience as a gift' line (Concierge Gift) fits, but the page should not chase voucher intent.
Intent mismatch risk: the page will rank best for the travel-flavoured long tail (unique, bucket list, luxury, romantic experiences) rather than the head term's local intent.
payload.recommended_angle: The travel-worthy version of 'couples experiences': 20 experiences abroad grouped by type, each tied to a destination we plan, with season, one honest caveat, and the safety or permit line linked to the official source. Shows the invisible work an advisor handles (timing, permits, operators, transfers, wet-weather fallbacks).
